[[Sinbi]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[Non-player character|NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons/items.

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Command Post}} (only after the following quest) follow the path toward Jahai Bluffs
**{{NPC location|Sunward Marches}} (during [[Building the Base: The Meeting]])

==Dialogue==
Sunward Marches:
:''"[[Kerendu|My father]] is a great man. However, he and [[Mubata|my brother]] are men of knowledge...not action. They argue and debate, pontificate and dispute, but in the end accomplish nothing. They came to you only because I took the initiative to speak to your friend [[Nerashi]]. If there's anything I can do to help, please let me know."''

Command post:
:''"I sure would love to get in on some of the action out there. But I guess for now, I'll have to do my part behind the scenes. So, tell me, have you found anything interesting lately?"''
